signals.text: Adorable hoodie. My granddaughter is 2 but because of the reviews I sized up to a 3T and it fits perfectly with enough room to be comfortable. She loved it.

Purchased for my 9 and 11 year grandson.  Sizing seemed ok.  Washed and dried nicely.  You get 2 pieces - jacket and pants. Fleece as stated.  Having said this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

I purchased two of these, one for my 8 year old grandson and one for my 11 year old grandson.  I chose the large and xlarge - both black.  The boys are average/small boys.  I think the jackets will fit perfectly - maybe runs a little small - but that's ok for my boys. The black is dark and full - not gray.  They washed and dried nicely.  zipper is smooth.
